name: grill-reel
label: Brothers on the Grill food reel

brief.Goal (one sentence): Make people hungry and order today.
brief.Audio: Sizzle, flame whoosh, plate hit; music under the SFX
brief.Look & feel references: Daniel Schiffer: speed ramps, slow-motion hero, sound design

panels.title: Flame hit
panels.action: Flame flares over the grill (shot at 120 fps).

panels.title: Slow-mo turn
panels.action: Kebab turned on the grill; ramp 3× → 0.3× on the turn.

panels.title: Plating
panels.action: Onto the plate; match cut on the motion.

panels.title: Price + order
panels.action: Item, price and the order line, big.

hardRules: Real food, real prices: the price on screen matches the current menu.
Anything slowed down was shot at 60–120 fps.
Every visual hit has a sound hit.
visualNotes: Recipe: product-broll (Daniel Schiffer); SpeedRamp for ramps; Grade look="food".
qaChecklist: Price and order line readable at phone size.
Loudness −14 LUFS; sizzle audible on phone speakers.
